item_gone.message: The entry no longer exists in amZettel.

list_gone.message: The list no longer exists in amZettel.

auth_failed.message: The connection to amZettel has ended. Please reconnect.

write_conflict.message: amZettel changed in the meantime. Check the current state before trying again.

purchase_readonly.message: A bought item can only be put back on the list, not edited.

purchase_not_deletable.message: Bought items cannot be deleted: they stay in amZettel's purchase history. On a shopping list the completed entries are exactly those, so there is nothing to remove. To put one back on the list, mark it as not completed.

calendar_gone.message: The calendar no longer exists in amZettel.

event_gone.message: The event no longer exists in amZettel.

meal_plan_gone.message: The meal plan no longer exists in amZettel.

series_occurrence.message: Single occurrences of a series can only be changed or deleted in the amZettel app. In Home Assistant, choose the whole series ("this and all future events" on its first occurrence).

series_following.message: "This and all future events" from a later occurrence can only be done in the amZettel app. In Home Assistant only the whole series can be changed or deleted (from its first occurrence).

event_mixed_bounds.message: Start and end must both be dates (all-day) or both be times.

event_end_before_start.message: The end lies before the start.

event_start_required.message: Give a start: start_date_time, or start_date for an all-day event.

unknown_category.message: The calendar has no category "{category}". Categories: {categories}.

invalid_time.message: "{value}" is neither a date nor a time.

period_end_before_start.message: The end of the period lies before its start.

not_an_event_calendar.message: {entity_id} is not an amZettel event calendar (meal plans are read-only).

not_a_meal_plan.message: {entity_id} is not an amZettel meal plan.

calendar_write_missing.message: This connection may not change calendars. Remove the integration and add it again with "Change calendars".

lists_write_missing.message: This connection may not change lists. Remove the integration and add it again with "Change lists".

category_calendar_category.message: A category calendar only takes events of its own category.

sync_duplicate_external_id.message: Every event of a sync needs its own external_id.

sync_empty.message: No events delivered. That would remove all events of this source in the period; if that is intended, set allow_empty.

refresh_failed.message: amZettel could not be reached to check the current state, so nothing was changed: {error}

write_premium_required_calendar.title: Calendars need amZettel Premium

write_premium_required_lists.title: Lists need amZettel Premium
write_premium_required_lists.description: Home Assistant tried to change a list of {account}, and amZettel refused: this needs amZettel Premium. This message disappears after the next successful change of a list.

write_not_permitted_calendar.title: Changing calendars is not allowed
write_not_permitted_calendar.description: amZettel does not let Home Assistant change calendars of {account}. Allow it in amZettel under Profile → Connected systems. This message disappears after the next successful change of a calendar.

write_not_permitted_lists.title: Changing lists is not allowed
write_not_permitted_lists.description: amZettel does not let Home Assistant change lists of {account}. Allow it in amZettel under Profile → Connected systems. This message disappears after the next successful change of a list.

add_event.name: Add event
add_event.description: Adds an event to an amZettel calendar. With an external ID it is idempotent: calling again with the same ID changes the event only where it differs.

end_date_time.name: End
end_date_time.description: End of a timed event (optional: without it the event is a point in time).

time_zone.name: Time zone
time_zone.description: Optional IANA zone, e.g. Europe/Vienna or UTC. Without an offset, start/end are clock times in this zone; with an offset, the instant is converted to this zone. Omit to use Home Assistant's configured zone. All-day dates are unchanged.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: First day of an all-day event.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: The day AFTER the last day, as in calendar.create_event (optional: one day).

category.name: Category
category.description: Category of the calendar, by name or ID. Without it the category stays as it is.

description.name: Description
description.description: Note of the event. Without it the note stays as it is.

external_id.name: External ID
external_id.description: Your own stable ID (e.g. of the source). The same ID always means the same event.

sync_events.name: Sync events
sync_events.description: Makes the events of one source in a period match the delivered list: creates new ones, changes differing ones and removes events of THIS source in the period that are no longer delivered. Other events are never touched.

source.name: Source
source.description: Name of the source, e.g. "waste". Events of different sources never mix.

events.name: Events
events.description: List of events, each with external_id, summary, start and optionally end, description, category. start/end as in calendar.get_events: a date (all-day, end = the day after) or a date and time.

start.name: Period start
start.description: Date or date and time. Only events of the source starting in the period are removed.

end.name: Period end
end.description: Date (counts fully) or date and time.

allow_empty.name: Allow an empty list
allow_empty.description: An empty list removes every event of the source in the period. Off by default, because a source that is briefly unavailable often delivers nothing.

add_item.name: Add item
add_item.description: Adds an entry to an amZettel list, with amount, unit, category and note.

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: Amount (default 1). On a shopping list amZettel adds it to an open entry of the same name.

category.name: Category
category.description: Category of the entry (shopping lists: the list's categories).

get_events.name: Get events
get_events.description: Returns the events of an amZettel calendar in a period as data, series expanded.

start.name: Start
start.description: Date or date and time (default: now).

end.name: End
end.description: Date (counts fully) or date and time (default: seven days after the start).

category.name: Category
category.description: Only events of this category (name or ID).

get_meals.name: Get meals
get_meals.description: Returns the meals of an amZettel meal plan in a period as data.

start.name: Start
start.description: Date or date and time (default: now).

end.name: End
end.description: Date (counts fully) or date and time (default: seven days after the start).

get_items.name: Get items
get_items.description: Returns the entries of an amZettel list as data.

include_completed.name: Include completed
include_completed.description: Also completed entries (shopping lists: what was bought recently).
